sources.note: All 9 pages captured: 212 of 212 submissions; prize names from each of the 41 winning project pages.

curator_notes: All 41 prize winners are analyzed records. The overall top three are ranked; track and sponsor prizes with several winners stay unranked because project pages do not show the order. Some prizes list more winners than project pages name (Societal Impact, Hardware, Prediction Markets). The theme comes from the 'Most on Theme Hack (Love)' prize. Taglines are CrafterWIKI paraphrases; domains assigned conservatively.
